messages:
maria: quick heads-up, support is getting a flood of 502/504 errors from hosted inference after the canary deploy ~09:11 UTC. customers calling in. link to spikes: https://grafana.redwood/d/hosted/gateway-5xx (chart)
oncall-bot: ALERT: gateway.5xx_rate > 3% for 5m in prod (rule: gateway-5xx-burst). incident channel created.
sanjay: seeing the same in traces — increased tail latency and a bunch of upstream timeouts to embedder service.
alex: which canary did we push? iirc we shipped the prefetch + batch-window tweak.
maria: canary applied flag: `prefetch_window_ms=150` on route `inference-hosted-v2` to reduce cold-starts. old value was 0 in prod. deploy id r2026.09-canary
liz: that flag touches KV prefetch + continuous batching? could amplify queueing under some token patterns.
noah: logs from gateway show timeouts to embedder pool:
```
2026-03-17T09:11:58Z ERROR gateway proxy: upstream timeout after 500ms route=inference-hosted-v2 worker=gpu-a1-12 req_id=98f3
2026-03-17T09:12:01Z WARN runtime: kvcache-prefetch miss, starting fetch route=inference-hosted-v2
2026-03-17T09:12:02Z ERROR batch-scheduler: enqueue latency=120ms window_ms=150 backlog=84
```
maria: reproducer from curl (toy):
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-lg-2","input":"hello"}'
-- result: 502 / quick gateway timeout ~500ms on v2 route (consistent on canary hosts)
alex: can someone check if the canary routing tag accidentally included more pods than intended? maybe traffic slice config was broadened.
sanjay: checking router: `traffic.slice=0.1` as expected, but canary service selector shows `batch-window=true` label — that's expected. however the rollout matrix has `region=all` set in the canary job, which accidentally targeted multiple regions instead of single region.
liz: oh — we intended single-region canary. that explains broader impact.
noah: oncall: recommend immediate rollback of canary flag flip. we can disable `prefetch_window_ms` via config toggle or rollback canary revision.
maria: i'm going to flip the config flag off for the canary group first (less blast radius), then rollback if that doesn't help. tagging eng-sre for rollback support.
deploy-bot: deploy request r2026.09: patch config `prefetch_window_ms` -> 0 for canary group submitted by maria. starting rollout.
alex: also please revert `continuous_batch.window_ms` if it's part of the same change set — that doubled in the patch.
sanjay: running quick query: 09:10->09:18, 5xx spike peaked at 9:13 with 6.8% 5xx on canary slice. after flag flip requested.
deploy-bot: config patch applied to canary at 09:15:12 UTC. waiting for stabilization.
noah: after flip, 5xx dropping in the canary slice, overall gateway 5xx now 1.2% and trending down.
oncall-bot: NOTE: customer-facing ticket #CS-8791 created and assigned to support-bot.
support-bot: notified impacted customers with ETA: investigating and mitigation in progress. will update in 30m.
maria: will keep an eye. if rates keep trending down to baseline (<0.5%), we will not rollback full revision.
alex: postmortem items so far: add a safety validation that canary region selector must not be `all`; require explicit region list. also add guardrail: prefetch_window_ms <= 50ms in canary unless opt-in.
liz: put a temporary automaton to revert batching window if queue backlog > 50 for >2m.
sanjay: follow-up check: need to scan other routes where prefetch_window_ms was set in the same deploy (embedding, rerank). create a small audit job.
maria: support-bot — please add affected customers list and send the 'we mitigated' note when 5xx < 0.5% for 10min.
support-bot: will do. updated CS-8791 and pinged customers.
noah: verifying traces: tail latency for embedder dropped back to normal after 09:17. looks like prefetch + batch window created backpressure on embedder under certain request shapes.
alex: good catch. thanks all for quick action. assign follow-up to eng-ml + eng-runtime for a proper load test scenario covering prefetch + batching combos.
maria: closing loop: we'll hold full rollout until we've run stress tests and added the region-canary guard. will schedule a postmortem doc (short) and link to it here.
support-bot: customers notified as of 09:32 UTC — closure pending postmortem. :white_check_mark:
maria: marking incident resolved for now; will reopen if anything repeats. thanks everyone. (reaction :party:)
__notes: Single-string Slack thread with root message and replies; messages in chronological order.
